title: The Harsh Reality Of Money #Shorts
transcript: money doesn't give happiness this is probably one of the biggest lies that we have all heard in our lives your net worth is a scale of how much freedom you actually if you are constantly worrying about how much money you need to pay for rent then you don't have the time to worry about your mental health or your relationships or your passions our schools don't teach us how to make money how to invest or how passive income works it's hidden away for the most intelligent and hard-working to figure out and if you don't figure it out you will live the 9-5 job which is never fulfilling and that is the harsh reality
